title: Recovery · no reciclar verificación ya ratcheted
mission: Reproducí por qué portfolio-eff034-live-stale-collision-refresh-observation-v1 sigue reapareciendo como recovery G8/G9 aunque la deuda de runtime EFF034 ya está canónicamente ratcheted. Repará el binding/normalización mínimo del allocator para que un verification debt ya satisfecho no vuelva a ser ordinary claimable sólo por edad. Conservá historia/diagnostics y no uses blacklist por job_id.
definition_of_done: Fixtures basados en los returns EFF034 G8 y G9 reproducen el stale recovery actual.
Una deuda de verificación canónicamente ratcheted permanece como evidencia histórica/diagnóstica pero no aparece como ordinary age-based recovery.
Recovery genérico retry-safe sigue sin cambios y no se agrega blacklist por job_id.
La regla se resuelve desde estado durable canónico sin arqueología manual por worker y pasa regresiones del allocator/ratchet.

consumer.on_pass: consume repair return and suppress stale ratcheted verification recovery
consumer.on_fail: preserve boundary with exact failing fixture

semantic_identity.problem: a verification job whose runtime evidence debt is already canonically ratcheted continues resurfacing as ordinary age-based recovery
acceptance: a canonically ratcheted verification debt stays visible as historical or diagnostic evidence but is not ordinary claimable recovery by age
eff034 g8 and g9 stale-hint returns reproduce the current allocator regression
generic retry-safe recovery remains unchanged and no job-id blacklist is introduced
regression tests prove current ratchet status is consumed without requiring per-worker archaeology
